summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package runs beacon.cjs from a postinstall lifecycle hook and again from index.js on require(). The beacon POSTs the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), install directory (__dirname), current working directory (process.cwd()), and Node version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The README self-describes the package as a dependency-confusion test shim whose sole function is reporting install metadata to a researcher-controlled host; the fire-on-install and fire-on-import callbacks execute without installer consent and send host-identifying data to an endpoint outside any legitimate registry or vendor infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
